name: ai-team-kb
description: Connects Claude to one shared Confluence page where a team lists projects, findings and datasets others can reuse. Loads a local copy at session start, checks relevance on each prompt, and adds lines only with your yes, as targeted edits.

page_url.title: Team Confluence page link
page_url.description: Link to your team's knowledge page in Confluence (ask the page owner). Stored in your own settings, never in this repo.
